grades.pick: Choose a grade to see what it says about the buyer.

A1.name: Excellent
A1.description: Exceptionally strong financial position and capacity to pay; highly resilient to adverse economic and market conditions.

A2.name: Very good
A2.description: Very strong financial position; the capacity to pay differs only slightly from the highest grade and withstands most adverse conditions.

B1.name: Good
B1.description: Sound financial position and a strong capacity to pay, though somewhat more sensitive to adverse changes in economic or business conditions.

B2.name: Acceptable
B2.description: Adequate capacity to pay under current conditions; adverse economic or business developments are more likely to weaken it.

C1.name: Weak
C1.description: Clear weaknesses in the financial position; payment depends on stable business conditions and faces significant uncertainties.

C2.name: Very weak
C2.description: Fragile financial position; the capacity to pay is vulnerable and depends on favourable business and economic conditions.

D.name: Unacceptable
D.description: Default, insolvency or a financial position so impaired that payment is unlikely.

format.title: Accepted file
format.file: CSV (comma, semicolon or tab; UTF-8 or Windows-1251) or Excel (.xlsx, .xls — the first sheet with data).
format.columns: A header row with a column of two-letter ISO country codes (headed «code», «ISO», «country_code» or «Код») and a column of categories («category», «classification» or «Категория»); other columns, and title lines above the header, are ignored.
format.unclassified: An empty cell, «-» or «n/a» in the category column means the country is not classified: it is left out of the import.
format.whole: Categories are whole numbers 0–7. In a CSV or Excel file three-letter codes (UZB) are not accepted. A date above the header or in the file name is offered as the effective date.
format.pdf: Best: the OECD's own PDF as published (cre-crc-current-english.pdf from oecd.org) — read as it is, three-letter codes converted, the «Valid as of» date offered as the effective date.
